descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Job Summary The Applications Engineer is responsible for evaluating customer requirements and developing technical and commercial proposals for industrial equipment solutions. This role serves as a critical link between customers, sales teams, and internal engineering/manufacturing to ensure accurate, timely, and competitive responses to inquiries. This position operates in a fast-paced, high-volume environment supporting distributors, OEMs, EPCs, and end users across a wide range of applications. Applications include Pulp and Paper, Biofuels, Foods, Chemical processing, Mining / Metals, Industrial wastewater, and Auxiliary equipment in other segments as needed. The Applications Group is a dynamic organization with both junior and senior engineers who possess a wide range of experience and competencies. This is a great opportunity to contribute to a growing company and offers great mentorship opportunities to enhance professional development. This role is designed as a foundational position with clear visibility into commercial strategy and customer engagement, offering a defined pathway into Accounts Management and outside sales roles. JOB DESCRIPTION POSITION: Applications Engineer DEPT: Sales Support LOCATION: Easley, SC Status: Salary/Exempt Shift: Days Reports To: Tendering Manager Key Responsibilities: Proposal & Technical Evaluation § Review customer RFQs, specifications, and datasheets to determine appropriate product selection § Perform pumping equipment sizing, selection, and configuration § Generate detailed quotations including scope, pricing, and lead time
• Customer & Sales Support § Serve as a technical resource for internal sales teams and external customers § Support distribution network with product selection, troubleshooting, and application guidance § Participate in distributor and customer calls, visits, and training as needed § Support sales efforts by contributing to technical sales strategy, participating in customer discussions, and developing an understanding of commercial drivers behind winning opportunities
• Cross-Functional Coordination § Work closely with the Project Management team to define documentation packages, testing requirements, and customer deliverables early in the quotation phase to ensure accurate scope, compliance, and execution readiness. § Collaborate with manufacturing, engineering, and supply chain to confirm feasibility, lead times, and cost § Work with global teams when required to support international or specialized opportunities § Ensure alignment between customer expectations and internal capabilities
• Quote and Opportunity Management § Manage multiple RFQs simultaneously in a high-volume environment § Maintain accurate records of opportunities, quotes, and communications in Salesforce (CRM system)
• Continuous Improvement & Team Support § Identify opportunities to improve quoting efficiency, accuracy, and standardization § Support development of tools, templates, and documentation § Assist in training new team members and sharing application knowledge Secondary Responsibilities:
• Perform other duties as assigned. Supervisory Responsibilities:
• None Qualifications:
• Required § Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering, chemical engineering, or related field. § 0-5 years of related engineering experience (industrial, process, applications, pumps & hydraulics preferred) § Strong analytical and problem-solving skills § Ability to manage multiple priorities under tight deadlines § Excellent communication skills (both written and verbal) § Willingness to travel as needed
• Preferred § Experience with pumps, fluid systems, or rotating equipment § Exposure to reading specifications and technical drawings § Familiarity with CRM syst
